message.content:
**July 4, 1776** – That’s when the Second Continental Congress formally adopted and approved the text of the *Declaration of Independence*.  

While the document itself was “signed” (i.e., officially accepted) on that day, most delegates did not affix their names to the parchment until **August 2, 1776**, when they gathered at the Pennsylvania State House (now Independence Hall). Thus:

| Event | Date |
|-------|------|
| Adoption/approval of the Declaration | **July 4, 1776** |
| First official signatures placed on the parchment | **August 2, 1776** |

So if you’re asking about the formal adoption, it was July 4; if you mean the actual signing ceremony, it took place on August 2.
